propositions: Two unmarked JSON derived files (index.json and criterion-pins.json) lack self-identifying markers, causing authors to cite them by line number, edit the wrong artifact, and fail drift gates repeatedly.
Regenerators must emit fixed-point markers that survive byte-identically across regenerations, so the markers themselves become the comparison baseline for drift gates.

A new consolidated docs table listing all nine derived/parity-gated surfaces with their regenerate commands and enforcing gates makes it discoverable which files are derived and which are hand-authored-but-gated.
Two existing on-disk equality tests must be re-pointed from the pure builder functions to the marker-bearing document builders to account for the added metadata.
A new test validates that the docs table row set exactly matches known derived surfaces and that each generated file carries its marker, catching surface additions that miss the table.
